checkpoints.question: Which command can show whether the shell can find `python3`?
checkpoints.model_answer: `command -v python3` shows what the shell would run, or indicates that the command is not found.

checkpoints.question: What does an exit status of `0` mean?
checkpoints.model_answer: An exit status of `0` means the command completed successfully.

checkpoints.question: When would you use `&&` instead of `||`?
checkpoints.model_answer: Use `&&` when the next command should run only if the previous command succeeds. Use `||` when the next command should run only if the previous command fails.
